one_sentence_failure_summary: Every warrior design emitted 'Ignored, redefinition of label' warnings that silently disabled scanner/attack instructions, yet the agent never fixed the root cause and misattributed failures to design choices rather than assembly errors, preventing any stable convergence to the required win thresholds.

This pattern of ignoring the warning propagates across every subsequent design (steps 17, 20, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30, 36, 88, 89, 90, 91, 92, 96, 97, 98, 99, 100, 104, 105, 106), ensuring no design ever functions as intended.

trigger_explanation: At step 12 the assembler warning 'Ignored, redefinition of label found' is explicitly printed in the terminal output, directly indicating that a key code block is being skipped. This same ignored signal repeats across 15+ steps covering every warrior design.
